# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome middle-aged man with iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes. His strong, sad face features splendid modeling around the brow and chin.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung, sensitive, and reserved man who scrupulously hides his deep and tender nature from the world. He is also noted for his pride, which prevents him from returning.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Twenty-five years after breaking off his engagement to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and moving to the [States](../codex/places.md#states) to work with his uncle, Stephen Irving returned to reconnect with her after being widowed two years prior. Upon his arrival at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), he reconnected with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) before meeting [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Their reunion led to a walk in the garden and culminated in their joyful wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), +4 more_

## Quotes

> “This is the one place where time stands still,” he said, looking around him with delighted eyes. “There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again.”
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving was formerly engaged to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) before a long-ago quarrel separated them. Years later, after his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) befriended Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Stephen reunited with her at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Their romantic connection was rekindled, culminating in a garden wedding.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), +14 more_
